trust_boundary: Authenticated request (sysadmin only) at the production nginx edge
reachability: Production nginx Grafana location; per infra/grafana-auth/README.md the live config is NOT in the repo — this file is the 'reviewed copy' of the Grafana blocks in /etc/nginx/sites-available/classroom.
defenses: Every request under /sysadmin/grafana/ first passes `auth_request /sysadmin/grafana/auth-check` (nginx-grafana.conf:35), an internal exact-match location proxied to Flask's sysadmin.grafana_auth_check (sysadmin BoundaryContext + timeout). So only an authenticated sysadmin could ever send Upgrade: h2c to Grafana. Gap: `proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade` forwards any client Upgrade value, not only websocket; if Grafana (127.0.0.1:3000) accepted h2c, a tunneled HTTP/2 stream would carry client-chosen headers — including X-WEBAUTH-USER/X-WEBAUTH-ROLE, which Grafana auth.proxy trusts — past nginx's per-request header overwrite. Precondition is already sysadmin, and Grafana's default HTTP server does not do h2c upgrade unless protocol=h2c is set.
constitutional: none directly; INV-ARC-002 (no implicit global access) is the closest principle if the auth-proxy identity could be chosen by the client
evidence: nginx-grafana.conf:51-53 `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade; proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";` with :48-49 `proxy_set_header X-WEBAUTH-USER $auth_user; proxy_set_header X-WEBAUTH-ROLE Admin;`.
recommended_action: Propose: `map $http_upgrade $grafana_upgrade { ~*^websocket$ websocket; default ""; }` and `map $grafana_upgrade $grafana_conn { websocket upgrade; default ""; }` in grafana-auth-redirect-map.conf, then use them in the location; extend infra/grafana-auth/test_harness.sh with a negative case (Upgrade: h2c is not forwarded) alongside the existing websocket-upgrade positive case. Apply to the live server per the README deploy steps.
uncertainty: Live nginx config and Grafana's [server] protocol setting cannot be verified from the repository; Cloudflare edge behaviour for Upgrade: h2c not verified.
